lesson.title: Antifragile Decisions
lesson.topic: How to make decisions that strengthen your system through stress and uncertainty.
lesson.steelman: What are the potential benefits of making antifragile decisions in high-stress environments?
lesson.example: A business owner decides to diversify their income streams during an economic downturn, leading to long-term stability and growth.

rationale: Teaches students how to apply antifragile principles in everyday decision-making for resilience.
